proposal.title: Proposals
proposal.subtitle: Pitch scope and price, track what the buyer does, and turn the winner into an invoice.
proposal.emptyMessage: Create your first proposal, send the link to your buyer and watch it move from sent to accepted.

estimate.title: Estimates
estimate.subtitle: Quote a price before you invoice. Send it, get it accepted, convert it in one click.
estimate.emptyMessage: Create your first estimate, send the link to your buyer and convert it to an invoice once accepted.

list.emptyFiltered: No document matches the search and filters. Try fewer filters or a different word.
list.emptyTab: When one of your {kind} reaches this status it will show up here.

bulk.label: Bulk actions
bulk.deleteMessage: {count, plural, one {# document will be deleted for good. Its public link stops working.} other {# documents will be deleted for good. Their public links stop working.}} Converted documents are kept.
bulk.deleted: {count, plural, one {# document deleted} other {# documents deleted}}
bulk.someFailed: {count, plural, one {# document could not be deleted} other {# documents could not be deleted}}

confirm.copyFailed: Could not copy the link. Select it and copy by hand.

markSent.title: Mark {number} as sent?
markSent.message: This records that the {kind} was shared with the buyer by hand (the link was copied). It does not send anything; use Send for that.

convertInvoice.title: Convert {number} to an invoice?
convertInvoice.message: An invoice draft is created with the same lines and totals and this {kind} is locked as converted. This cannot be undone.

convertDeal.title: Create a deal from {number}?
convertDeal.message: A deal is created with this {kind}'s total and contact, and linked back to it.

delete.title: Delete {number}?
delete.message: The {kind} is deleted for good and its public link stops working. Its number is never reused.

confirm.linkCopiedInactive: Link copied. The buyer cannot open it until the document is sent.

accept.title: Record {number} as accepted?
accept.message: Use this when {name} agreed outside the link, by phone or with a signed copy. It is recorded in the activity as entered by you, not as the buyer's own signature.

decline.title: Record {number} as declined?
decline.message: Use this when {name} said no outside the link. The {kind} closes as declined; you can revise it into a new draft later.

extend.title: Extend {number}
extend.message: Give this {kind} a new valid-until date. An expired one becomes open again for {name}.
extend.past: The date cannot be in the past.

revise.title: Revise {number}?
revise.message: The {kind} goes back to a draft so you can change it (the revision number goes up and the old content is kept). The buyer cannot accept the old version once you change it.

confirm.noteHint: Kept in the activity with this decision.

errors.network: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to do that.
errors.signedOut: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
errors.conflict: Someone else changed this document. It was reloaded; review it and try again.
errors.validation: Some of the values were not accepted. Check the highlighted fields.
errors.unavailable: Proposals and estimates are not available on this server yet.
errors.rateLimited: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.notFound: This document was not found. It may have been deleted.
errors.planDisabled: Your plan does not include proposals and estimates.
errors.invalidTransition: That change is not allowed from the document's current status. It was reloaded.
errors.notEditable: Only a draft can be edited. Revise the document to go back to a draft.
errors.notDeletable: Accepted and converted documents are kept as a record and cannot be deleted.
errors.alreadyDecided: This document was already decided. It was reloaded.
errors.alreadyConverted: This document was already converted to an invoice.
errors.alreadyLinkedDeal: This document already has a deal linked.
errors.linkUnavailable: The public link was revoked or has expired. Make a new link first.
errors.noRecipient: Add the buyer's email or phone first, then send.
errors.sendFailed: The message could not be delivered, so the document was not marked as sent. Try again.
errors.expired: This document has passed its valid-until date. Extend it first.
errors.ownerInvalid: The owner must be an active member of the workspace.
errors.invoicingUnavailable: Invoicing is not available yet, so this document cannot be converted.

picker.searchContact: Search contacts by name, email or phone
picker.phoneHint: With the country code, for example +971 50 123 4567.
picker.forbidden: You do not have permission to create contacts.
picker.createFailed: The contact could not be created. Try again.

send.title: Send {number}
send.linkHint: Anyone with this link can view the document and accept or decline it. Share it only with the buyer.
send.copyFailed: Could not copy the link. Select it and copy by hand.
send.noEmail: This document has no buyer email. Type one here.
send.messageDefault: Hello {name}, here is our document. It shows the scope and the price, and you can accept it online.
send.messageHint: The link to the document is added under your message.
send.noPhone: This document has no buyer phone number. Add one in the buyer details first.
send.markSent: I shared it: mark as sent
send.linkUnavailable: The link is not available on this server yet.
send.stateDraft: The link opens once the document is sent. Until then the buyer sees nothing.
send.stateRevoked: This link was revoked: the buyer cannot open it. Make a new one to share again.
send.stateActive: {views, plural, =0 {Not opened yet.} one {Opened once.} other {Opened # times.}}
send.stateInactive: This link has expired and the buyer cannot open it. Make a new one.
send.regenerateWarning: The old link stops working at once. Anyone who has it will see that it is no longer available.
send.waHint: Send queues the message on your connected WhatsApp and marks the document as sent. Open in WhatsApp lets you send it yourself; then use the Link tab to mark it as sent.

activity.title: Activity of {number}
activity.subtitle: Everything that happened to this document, newest first.
activity.unavailable: The activity history is not available on this server yet.
activity.empty: Nothing has happened to this document yet.
activity.recordedByStaff: Recorded by a team member on the buyer's behalf

builder.notFound: This document does not exist or was deleted.
builder.newSubtitle: Fill in the buyer and the line items. The number is assigned when you save this {kind}.
builder.leaveMessage: This page has changes that are not saved. If you leave now they will be lost.
builder.fixErrors: Some fields need attention before this can be saved.

locked.sent: This document is out with the buyer, so it cannot be edited. Revise it to go back to a draft, or duplicate it for a new one.
locked.accepted: This document was accepted and is kept as a record. Convert it to an invoice, or duplicate it for a new one.
locked.converted: This document was converted to an invoice and is locked.

buyer.title: Buyer
buyer.hint: Pick a contact or type the buyer's details. Their email and phone are used to send.
buyer.name: Buyer name
buyer.phoneHint: With the country code. Needed to send on WhatsApp.

items.title: Line items
items.hint: Quantities can have decimals. Discount is a percentage or an amount (tap the sign in the box to switch); a blank tax uses the document's rate.
items.discountToAmount: Row {n}: discount is a percentage; switch to an amount
items.discountToPercent: Row {n}: discount is an amount; switch to a percentage

problems.noItems: Add at least one line item with a description and a price.
problems.descriptionTooLong: The description is too long (500 characters at most).
problems.qtyInvalid: Quantity must be a number, 0 or more, with up to 4 decimals.
problems.priceInvalid: Enter the unit price as a number, 0 or more.
problems.discountInvalid: Discount must be a percentage from 0 to 100.
problems.taxInvalid: Tax must be a percentage from 0 to 100.
problems.docDiscountInvalid: Enter the discount as a number, 0 or more.
problems.docTaxInvalid: Tax must be a percentage from 0 to 100.
problems.phoneInvalid: Enter the phone with the country code, for example +971 50 123 4567.
problems.titleTooLong: The title is too long (255 characters at most).
problems.notesTooLong: The notes are too long (5,000 characters at most).
problems.termsTooLong: The terms are too long (10,000 characters at most).
problems.tooLarge: An amount is too large. Reduce a quantity or a price.

totals.defaultTaxHint: Applied to every row that has no tax of its own.

preview.title: Preview
preview.hint: This is what the buyer sees and what prints. Totals use the same rounding as the saved document.

thanks.label: Thank you
thanks.text: Thank you for the opportunity to work with you. We look forward to getting started.

scope.label: Scope reminder
scope.text: This document covers only the items listed above. Anything outside this scope will be quoted separately.

followUp.label: Next steps
followUp.text: To go ahead, accept this document online. We will confirm the start date within one business day.

net14.label: Payment in 14 days
net14.text: Payment is due within 14 days of the invoice date.

net30.label: Payment in 30 days
net30.text: Payment is due within 30 days of the invoice date.

deposit50.label: 50% deposit
deposit50.text: A 50% deposit is due on acceptance. The balance is due on completion.

warranty.label: Warranty
warranty.text: Work is warranted for 90 days from delivery against defects in workmanship.

linked.title: Proposals and estimates
linked.unavailable: Proposals and estimates are not available on this server yet.

signature.area: Signature box: draw your signature with your finger, pen or mouse

invalid.title: This link is not valid
invalid.message: The document may have been removed, or the link is incomplete. Ask the sender for a new link.

error.title: We could not load the document
error.message: Check your connection and try again. If it keeps happening, contact the sender.

banner.accepted: You accepted this {kind}. {seller} has been notified and will follow up.
banner.declinedHint: If this was a mistake, please contact {seller}.
banner.converted: Accepted. An invoice has been issued for this {kind}.
banner.expiredHint: It can no longer be accepted. Contact {seller} to ask for a new one.

decision.title: Your decision
decision.intro: Accepting this {kind} for {total} confirms the scope and pricing above with {seller}.
decision.name: Your full name
decision.nameHint: Typed as your name on the record (at least 2 characters).
decision.useTyped: Sign with my typed name instead of drawing
decision.signatureRequired: Draw your signature, or choose to sign with your typed name.
decision.agree: I have read this {kind} and I accept its scope, price and terms.
decision.note: Your name, signature, the time and your network address are recorded with your decision.
decision.declineMessage: {seller} will be told you declined. You will not be able to change this afterwards.
decision.reasonHint: A short note helps {seller} understand what to adjust.

problem.expired: This document has expired and can no longer be accepted.
problem.closed: This document was already decided. The page has been refreshed.
problem.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
problem.validation: Some of your details were not accepted. Check your name and try again.
problem.generic: We could not record your decision. Check your connection and try again.
problem.gone: This link is no longer active.

gone.title: This link is no longer active
gone.message: The sender turned this link off or it ran out. Ask them for a new link.
